en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Hammad Bin Usman, from Al Waleed Bin Sabeeh who said,

‘I said to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, ‘It has reached us that an Umra performed during the Month of Ramazaan equates to a Hajj’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘But rather, that was regarding a woman promised by Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>. So he<sup>saww</sup> said to her: ‘Perform Umra during a month of Ramazan, so it would be a Hajj for you’.
en.sarwar: 1. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Hammad ibn ‘Uthman from al-Walid ibn Sabih who has said the following: “I once said to abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, ‘It is narrated to us that performing al-‘Umrah in the month of Ramadan is equal to al-Hajj.

He (the Imam) said, ‘This was only about a woman to whom the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, had promised saying, “Perform al-‘Umrah in the month of Ramadan; it will be al-Hajj for you.’””
